sources.finding: California treats corporations and LLCs as separate entity types. LLCs file Articles of Organization; corporations file Articles of Incorporation.

sources.title: CES ATAD 2027 Pitch Rules Final.pdf, Section 2
sources.finding: The rules require an incorporated nonprofit or for-profit organization, good standing in its state of origin, and a principal business location in the US or DC. They do not expressly list LLCs.
